div.div: 5 تسعّب It (a thing, TA, [such as saliva, and any thick liquid,]) roped; i. e. drew out, with a viscous, glutinous, cohesive, sticky, ropy, or slimy, continuity of parts; or was, or became, viscous, glutinous, cohesive, sticky, ropy, or slimy; syn. تَمَطَّطَ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
